title: Mechanism
description: A named technical building block that implements one or more capabilities. Mechanisms are the implementation vocabulary — they live below capabilities but above raw code. Naming mechanisms explicitly allows the estate to detect when the same pattern is re-implemented across multiple systems.

mechanism_id.description: Stable slug. e.g. generation-fenced-leases, vector-similarity-index, mcp-tool-registry

pattern_class.description: The abstract design pattern this mechanism belongs to. Enables cross-system pattern queries.

implementation_refs.description: Pinned file:line-range references at a specific source_head. Format: owner/repo@sha:path/to/file.ext:L84-L161

evidence_ids.description: claim_ids from evidence.schema.json that verify this mechanism works

reuse_count.description: Number of distinct systems using this mechanism. Computed by estate engine. High reuse = extraction candidate.

extraction_candidate.description: true when reuse_count >= 2 and mechanism is not yet in a shared library. Populated by estate engine.
